description: This file defines the 'Operation' class which models an API operation in the AWS SDK for PHP. It manages input/output shapes, errors, HTTP attributes, and context parameters related to an API call.

classes.name: Operation
classes.description: Represents and manages details of an API operation, including request/response shapes, errors, and context parameters.

methods.name: getHttp
methods.description: Returns the HTTP method and request URI for the operation.

methods.name: getInput
methods.description: Returns the input shape of the operation, initializing it if necessary.

methods.name: getOutput
methods.description: Returns the output shape of the operation, initializing it if necessary.

methods.name: getErrors
methods.description: Returns an array of error shapes associated with the operation.

methods.name: getStaticContextParams
methods.description: Returns static context parameters used for endpoint resolution.

methods.name: getContextParams
methods.description: Returns dynamic context parameters used for endpoint resolution.

methods.name: setContextParams
methods.description: Private method to set context parameters based on input shape members.
